notes.title: ULTIMATE Hard Minus is out!
notes.content:
- Added guns: Flamethrower and burstfire SMG.
- Released classic episode, which means map pack from original Hard Minus game. Nostalgia...
- Fixed some micro bugs.

notes.title: Final update!
notes.content:
- Final released.
- Added cutscenes.
- Added two more levels in Taiga section.
- Little rebalance.
- Some cosmetic changes.

Thanks a lot for supporting, that's mean a lot for me <3

notes.title: Week-one updates!
notes.content:
[b]YOLO game mode:[/b]

Challenge yourself in mode for ultra-uber-mega harcoreguys YOLO — one live on walkthrough (except hell section). Mode will be available after beating game on every difficulty.

[b]Some bugfixes and corrections:[/b]

- New look for endgame screen.
- Final stopwatch showing proper time.
- Handrails are fixed.
- Russian localizations typo are fixed.
- Hitboxes of enemies little-bit fixed too.
